scientific_findings.convergence_status: Non-converged demonstration baseline (3 epochs on 100 sample subset)
scientific_findings.physics_explanation: S-UNIWARD embeds ±1 ternary perturbations into complex textures; standard spatial downsampling / average pooling averages out adjacent opposing ±1 steps (sum ~ 0).
scientific_findings.scientific_guidance: Paired reference comparison provides empirical differential modification evidence (exact altered pixels, percentage, PSNR, ternary symmetry) without artificial probability inflation. Statistical attacks (Chi-Square, SPA, RS) specifically target spatial LSB replacement and do not detect spatial ternary S-UNIWARD. Single-image S-UNIWARD detection requires high-capacity architectures (such as SRNet) with extensive GPU training across 10,000 BOSSbase pairs.
